answer: Before a payout, the desk posts a sealed letter to the address on file, carrying a one-time code tied to a willow branch printed on the envelope. The claimant must return the code within a week; the desk checks it the same day. A wrong or missing code voids the claim and bars the address for a month. One honest worker receives one letter at home for free, while 1,000 fakes would need 1,000 real mailboxes across the tundra, each checked daily. One farm rented fifty boxes beside one river; the postman delivered fifty letters to one door, and the desk voided them all.
